working_title: Noah's Ark and the Flood Begins: Genesis 5-7 Bible Story (KJV)

hook.text: What if obeying God meant building alone, while the whole world laughed? Genesis five to seven. Watch what most people miss: God himself shut the door.

close.text: Noah obeyed before one drop of rain fell. So here is my honest question: what are you waiting to see, before you trust God?
